description: Kerala Police has launched Hackup 2026, a nationwide hackathon under CoCon 2026, inviting innovators, startups and cybersecurity experts to develop AI-based tools for cyber investigations. The initiative aims to enhance digital policing, analyse evidence efficiently and strengthen responses to emerging cyber threats
body_lead: Home |India |Kerala Police Launch Hackup 2026 To Develop Ai Powered Solutions Against Cybercrime Kerala police launch ‘Hackup 2026’ to develop AI-powered solutions against cybercrime Kerala Police has launched Hackup 2026, a nationwide hackathon under CoCon 2026, inviting innovators, startups and cybersecurity experts to develop AI-based tools for cyber investigations.
